events.title: Ignite the Depths Demo 1.0.2
events.summary: Hey everyone,This patch is mostly about combat.Combat ChangesEnemies will now register hits on players much more consistently. This is largely to prevent circle strafing.Goblin and Skeleton base movement speed has been moderately increased. This is to make kiting a bit more challenging.Some skeletons will now have iron helmets which cannot be hit through.Dev note: All three changes listed above have the goal of making combat against common enemies more engaging. Not necessarily harder. Feedback

events.title: Demo Patch 1.0.1
events.summary: Hey everyone,It's been a wild day! I've had fun watching everyone find all the new tidbits and play with the new systems. I've fixed some of the major bugs that have come up as well as some balancing. Fixed an issue where enemies wouldn't swing at a player, and will just do circles.Improved the internal aggro system that controls enemies. events.title: Ignite the Depths Is Participating in This Months Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey everyone,We're releasing a public demo for this month's Next Fest! We'll be releasing the demo on October 19th at 9:00 AM PST. We'll notify wishlisters via email when we release the demo. events.title: Playtest available now!
events.summary: Hey everyone,Our playtest is now available to everyone who wants to hop in!This is an early version of what's to come, so expect missing features and bugs. Filling out feedback helps us a ton so we appreciate everyone who does. As the day goes on today, expect hotfixes for the things you're reporting. There will also be a surprise in the coming days... We hope you all have fun, even if you encounter some bugs,Marcus

events.title: Playtest Pushed Back to September 10th-14th!
events.summary: Hey everyone,We're pushing back our playtest date by just a week, meaning we're going to start on September 10th now. This is mostly about having a bit more polish than initially planned, as we're going to have a lot more people than expected have their hands on it.
